# procedural

The goal of **procedural** is to provide a set of tools for working with
the **2024 ICD-10-PCS** procedure classification system.

# 📦 Installation

You can install **`procedural`** from [GitHub](https://github.com/)
with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("andrewallenbruce/procedural")
```

# 🔰 Usage

``` r

library(procedural)
```

**ICD-10-PCS**, or **the International Classification of Diseases, 10th
Revision, Procedure Coding System**, is a procedure classification
system used to code procedures performed in hospital inpatient health
care settings.

## Codes

``` r

pcs("0LQV3ZZ") # Medical and Surgical
```

``` R
#> $code
#> [1] "0LQV3ZZ"
#> 
#> $description
#> [1] "Repair Right Foot Tendon, Percutaneous Approach"
#> 
#> $axes
#> # A tibble: 7 × 4
#>    axis name        value label               
#>   <int> <chr>       <chr> <chr>               
#> 1     1 Section     0     Medical and Surgical
#> 2     2 Body System L     Tendons             
#> 3     3 Operation   Q     Repair              
#> 4     4 Body Part   V     Foot Tendon, Right  
#> 5     5 Approach    3     Percutaneous        
#> 6     6 Device      Z     No Device           
#> 7     7 Qualifier   Z     No Qualifier        
#> 
#> $definitions
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   label        definition                                                       
#>   <chr>        <chr>                                                            
#> 1 Repair       Restoring, to the extent possible, a body part to its normal ana…
#> 2 Percutaneous Entry, by puncture or minor incision, of instrumentation through…
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "pcs"  "list"
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## ⚖️ Code of Conduct

Please note that the `provider` project is released with a [Contributor
Code of
Conduct](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

  

## 🏛️ Governance

This project is primarily maintained by [Andrew
Bruce](https://github.com/andrewallenbruce). Other authors may
occasionally assist with some of these duties.

# Package index

## PCS Machinery

ICD-10-PCS Building Blocks.

- [`code_range()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/code_range.md)
  : Return a range of ICD-10-PCS codes
- [`definitions()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/definitions.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Definitions
- [`devices()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/devices.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Devices
- [`includes()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/includes.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Includes
- [`index()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/index-topic.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Index
- [`order()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/order.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Order File
- [`pcs()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/pcs.md)
  : Look up ICD-10-PCS Codes or Tables
- [`pcs_code()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/pcs_code.md)
  : Look up ICD-10-PCS Codes or Tables
- [`sections()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/sections.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Sections
- [`systems()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/systems.md)
  : ICD-10-PCS Body Systems

## Presentation Options

Tools for Visualization and Presentation.

- [`gt_pcs()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/gt_pcs.md)
  :

  Return ICD-10-PCS Code as a `gt` Table

- [`gt_pcs2()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/gt_pcs2.md)
  :

  Return ICD-10-PCS Code as a `gt` Table

## Validators

Functions to validate inputs.

- [`is_section_code()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/is_section_code.md)
  : Validate Full PCS Codes by Section
- [`is_section_value()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/is_section_value.md)
  : Validate Section Values
- [`is_system_value()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/procedural/reference/is_system_value.md)
  : Validate System Values
